topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The rain's been pouring down, but nothing like what I found when I climbed up into that attic. The place was like a time capsule, packed with old trunks and boxes, the air thick with the smell of dust and secrets. This wasn't just leftover junk. There were letters, dated back decades, photographs so faded you had to squint to make out the faces. And then there was the diary, tucked away in a corner, bound in leather and locked tight. The homeowner, she seemed nervous, like she knew there was more to these items than just forgotten memories. I gave her a look, told her we'd need to take a closer look. Something about this didn't sit right, and in this city, that's the kind of feeling you can't afford to ignore.
